machine=imx95-frdm
initramfs_file=avocado-image-initramfs-imx95-frdm.cpio.zst
devicetree_file=imx95-15x15-frdm.dtb
kernel_file=Image

console=ttyLP0,115200
devtype=mmc
devnum=1
mmcblk=1
bootpart=3
rootdev=/dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p5

image_addr=0x90400000
fdt_addr=0x93000000
fdt_overlay_addr=0x93400000
overlay_env_addr=0x93600000
ramdisk_addr=0x93800000

# Slot A/B only: no recovery partition. An unset or invalid slot boots A.
avocado_boot_init=\
  if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "b"; then\
    echo "Booting B";\
    setenv bootpart 4;\
    setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p6;\
  else\
    if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" != "a"; then\
      echo "avocado_boot_slot=${avocado_boot_slot} unset or invalid";\
    fi;\
    echo "Booting A";\
    setenv bootpart 3;\
    setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p5;\
  fi;\
  setenv bootargs audit=0 console=${console} root=${rootdev} rootwait;

load_image=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${image_addr} ${kernel_file}
# The project's choices from avocado.yaml, delivered at build time by the
# device-tree-overlay-deliver hook as avocado-overlays.txt on this slot's boot
# FAT: avocado_fdt_overlays (boot FAT paths of .dtbo files) and
# avocado_devicetree_file (a base .dtb in place of devicetree_file). The import
# names those two variables, so no other line in the file can reach the
# environment, and it clears them first, so a slot without the file (no
# overlays declared, the common case) boots the machine defaults.
avocado_import_overlays=\
  setenv avocado_fdt_overlays;\
  setenv avocado_devicetree_file;\
  if load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${overlay_env_addr} avocado-overlays.txt; then\
    env import -t ${overlay_env_addr} ${filesize} avocado_fdt_overlays avocado_devicetree_file;\
  fi;\
  true

load_devicetree=\
  if test -n "${avocado_devicetree_file}"; then\
    load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${fdt_addr} ${avocado_devicetree_file};\
  else\
    load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${fdt_addr} ${devicetree_file};\
  fi

# Apply each project overlay onto the loaded base DTB. Needs the base built with
# -@ (symbols) and U-Boot's libfdt overlay support (dt-overlays.cfg). resize
# gives libfdt headroom for every fragment; a missing or bad overlay warns and
# is skipped rather than aborting the boot.
apply_overlays=\
  fdt addr ${fdt_addr};\
  fdt resize 0x40000;\
  for ov in ${avocado_fdt_overlays}; do\
    echo "Applying DT overlay ${ov}";\
    if load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${fdt_overlay_addr} ${ov}; then\
      fdt apply ${fdt_overlay_addr} || echo "WARN: fdt apply ${ov} failed";\
    else\
      echo "WARN: overlay ${ov} not found on boot partition";\
    fi;\
  done
load_initramfs=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${ramdisk_addr} ${initramfs_file}

avocado_boot=booti ${image_addr} ${ramdisk_addr}:${filesize} ${fdt_addr};

bootcmd=run avocado_boot_init avocado_import_overlays load_image load_devicetree apply_overlays load_initramfs avocado_boot
